description: Sends Solidmade a job request on the user's behalf. Only call it after the user agrees to share their email and site link. Solidmade replies to that email from hello@solidmade.co within one business day with one fixed price and a date; nothing starts and nothing is charged until the user agrees.

budget_optional.description: Optional budget or price the user has in mind.

contact_email.description: The user's email, where Solidmade sends the price.

service_id_optional.description: Optional service id from list_services if one fits.

site_url.description: Link to the store, site, workflow or file the job is about.

what_they_need.description: The job in plain words: what's broken or what should be built, any deadline.

name: request_quote
title: Ask Solidmade for a fixed price
